description: This file defines a Data Transfer Object (DTO) class 'InterviewAttachmentSearchFilterParams' used to encapsulate filtering parameters for searching interview attachments within the OrangeHRM recruitment module. It extends a base filter parameters class and specifies allowed sort fields, primarily 'attachment.id' and 'attachment.interviewId'. The class includes a property for the interview ID, with corresponding getter and setter methods, and initializes default sorting behavior.

classes.name: InterviewAttachmentSearchFilterParams
classes.description: DTO class for search filters related to interview attachments, allowing specification of interview ID and sort options.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter params with default sort field set to 'attachment.interviewId'.

methods.name: getInterviewId
methods.description: Retrieves the interview ID used as a filter criterion.

methods.name: setInterviewId
methods.description: Sets the interview ID for filtering.
